months.9: Cooler temperatures and golden alpine larches make for excellent hiking, though Larch Valley is extremely busy in the second half of the month, though early snowstorms can temporarily close the highest passes.

months.8: Heavy rains continue to batter the Himalayas, keeping the main tea-house treks muddy, dangerous, and completely clouded in. The arid rain-shadow regions, such as Upper Mustang and Dolpo, are the real hiking options.

months.9: Snow melts at lower elevations, but refugios and campsites stay closed to independent hikers until October, so multi-day treks need a guide.
months.12: One of the best months to walk the W and O treks, with maximum daylight for the long, strenuous days on the trail. All boat and shuttle access to the trailheads is running.
